featured_reviews.review_text:
Pathetic service..LIARS

The service advisor/executive, Priyanka (Powai service center), repeatedly provided false and misleading information throughout the day. From the morning onwards, she kept assuring me that the driver was already on the way, driving towards my location, and would arrive shortly.

However, after several hours of waiting and sensing that something was wrong, I requested the driver's contact number directly. To my surprise, when I spoke with the driver, I discovered that no pickup had even been assigned to him. This clearly established that the information being provided to me was inaccurate.

I then contacted Priyanka again, expecting transparency and a resolution. Instead, I was once again given the same assurances that she had spoken to the driver and that everything was being handled. Unfortunately, these statements were inconsistent with the facts I had already verified myself.

Delays can happen, and customers understand operational challenges. What is unacceptable is being repeatedly misled. If there was a delay in assigning a driver, I would have appreciated an honest update. Instead, I was made to wait for hours based on information that turned out to be untrue.

My concern is not only the missed pickup but also the complete lack of professional communication and accountability. I would like to understand:

1. Why was incorrect information repeatedly communicated to me?
2. Why was a pickup scheduled for 9:30 AM without proper driver assignment?
3. What action will be taken to ensure customers are not misled in this manner in the future?
